title: Adorable but doesn’t stack
text:
Adorable but doesn’t stack. I was very excited about this item as I redid my kitchen in white French farmhouse. When it arrived I saw that it is absolutely adorable, but it is not made to stack- at least mine isn’t. :(
If I stacked it like it is in the picture the top would surely fall off- the pieces don’t fit together. (That was why I bought it- because it stacked) I can still use it of course, but may return.

product_metadata.title: Mud Pie Fleur de Lis Stacked Cream and Sugar 3 Piece Set
features: Milk glazed terracotta "cream" pitcher and "sugar" pot with lid features raised Fleur de Lis icons and beaded detail.
description: 3-piece set. Milk glazed terracotta "cream" pitcher and "sugar" pot with lid features raised Fleur de Lis icons and beaded detail. Pieces stack for storage.
